en-US.longDescription: KBlackbox is a game of hide and seek played on a grid of boxes where the computer has hidden several balls. The position of the hidden balls can be deduced by shooting beams into the box.
en-US.name: kblackbox

zh-CN.longDescription: KBlackbox 是一款在方格中捉迷藏的游戏，而电脑会在方格中隐藏一些球。通过射出光柱即可推导出隐藏球的位置。
